classification.difficultyReason: Students judge the direction of each point cloud and use it to choose the slope and placement of a straight line, balancing the points and their distances above and below even when the trend is weak. They then describe direction and strength from the plots.

content.prompt: Copy these scatter plots and draw a line of best fit by eye through each.

spec.description: Thirteen points on unticked, unnumbered perpendicular axes. No axis names, units, arrows or fitted line are supplied.
spec.mathematics: Point positions reconstructed in a local pixel-relative coordinate frame; coordinates are construction data and are not printed numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Points and axes visible; fitted line appears only in answers.

answer.short: An upward-sloping straight line through the middle of the points; reasonable variations are acceptable.
answer.worked: Draw an upward-sloping straight line through the middle of the scatter, balancing the points above and below while considering their distances from the line. The wide scatter allows some variation in placement.

spec.description: Sample increasing fitted line using the exact base coordinate frame and bounding box.
spec.mathematics: A straight line fitted by eye; its placement is approximate rather than a numerical regression result.

spec.description: Dense descending scatter on unticked, unnumbered perpendicular axes without labels or a fitted line.
spec.mathematics: Pixel-relative reconstruction of the narrow descending point cloud. Construction coordinates are not student-visible data.
spec.answerVisibility: Points and axes visible; fitted line appears only in answers.

answer.short: A downward-sloping straight line through the centre of the narrow point cloud.
answer.worked: Draw a downward-sloping straight line through the centre of the narrow cloud. Keep roughly equal numbers of points above and below, considering their distances from the line.

spec.description: Sample decreasing fitted line using the exact base coordinate frame and bounding box.
spec.mathematics: Straight line following the strong negative association by eye.

spec.description: Twenty-two points forming a broad increasing cloud on unticked, unnumbered perpendicular axes.
spec.mathematics: Point positions reconstructed in a local pixel-relative coordinate frame without invented scale labels.
spec.answerVisibility: Points and axes visible; fitted line appears only in answers.

answer.short: An upward-sloping straight line through the middle of the point cloud.
answer.worked: Draw an upward-sloping straight line through the centre of the cloud, leaving roughly equal numbers of points above and below and considering their distances from the line.

spec.description: Sample increasing fitted line using the exact base coordinate frame and bounding box.
spec.mathematics: Straight line fitted by eye through the moderately dispersed increasing cloud.

spec.description: Fifteen broadly dispersed points on unticked, unnumbered perpendicular axes without labels or a fitted line.
spec.mathematics: Pixel-relative reconstruction of a weak decreasing association, retaining the individual points and their relative positions.
spec.answerVisibility: Points and axes visible; fitted line appears only in answers.

answer.short: A downward-sloping straight line through the middle of the points; reasonable variations are acceptable.
answer.worked: Draw a downward-sloping straight line through the centre of the scatter, balancing points above and below while considering their distances from the line. The weak association permits more variation in placement.

spec.description: Sample decreasing fitted line using the exact base coordinate frame and bounding box.
spec.mathematics: A straight line fitted by eye through the broad decreasing cloud.

children.prompt: In the scatter plots in the preceding question, comment on the following.

children.label: e
children.prompt: Do the scatter plots display an increasing or decreasing trend?

answer.short: Plot a: increasing; plot b: decreasing; plot c: increasing; plot d: decreasing.
answer.worked:
Read the overall direction of each point cloud from left to right.

Plot a: the points tend upwards — increasing.

Plot b: the points tend downwards — decreasing.

Plot c: the points tend upwards — increasing.

Plot d: the points tend downwards — decreasing.

children.label: f
children.prompt: What is the strength of the relationships between $y$ and $x$?

answer.short: Plot a: weak; plot b: strong; plot c: moderate; plot d: weak.
answer.worked:
Judge how closely the points follow the overall trend.

Plot a: the points are widely scattered — weak.

Plot b: the points lie close to a straight-line trend — strong.

Plot c: the points follow an upward trend with noticeable scatter — moderate.

Plot d: the points are widely scattered around a downward trend — weak.
